Biscotti tondi di frolla al vino bianco,: Round biscuits with white wine, golden and sprinkled with walnuts or almonds.
Biscottini sottili di burro, zucchero a: Thin butter cookies, icing sugar, flour and egg whites, for tea.
Biscotto di mandorle ripieno di confettu: Almond biscuit filled with cherry or grape jam. Friable and a little gummy inside, it serves with coffee.
Biscotto natalizio con frutta secca e sp: Christmas cookie with dried fruit and spices. Friable and spicy, they serve for Christmas with sweet wine.
Bistecche cotte adagio con aglio e rosma: Cooked steaks adage with garlic and rosemary, with potatoes in the intint.

Bocconcini di pasta di farina e acqua bo: Boiled and seasoned butter and cheese with flour and boiling water.
Bocconcini di pollo con mandorle e salsa: Chicken buns with almonds and soy sauce, served with a raw salad of radishes, cardoons, carrot and red cabbage.

Bocconcini di pollo passati in pangratta: Chicken buns passed into breadcrumbs, thyme, sage and rosemary and gratin in the oven, with lemon.
Bocconcini di pollo rosolati con cipolla: Sautéed chicken buns with onion and rosemary and cooked with tomato, green olives and pine nuts.
Bocconcini di salmone cotti in un sugo d: Salmon buns cooked in a tomato sauce, onion and peas, scented with basil and parsley.
Bocconcini di vitellone rosolati in cass: Sautéed veal buns in casserole with oil, garlic and laurel, in the genoese way.

Braciole di maiale cotte adagio in strut: Pork chops cooked adage in lard and butter with slices of polenta.
Braciole di maiale cotte un'ora e mezza: Pork chops cooked an hour and a half with butter, celery, leeks, carrots and potatoes.
Braciole di maiale fiorentine col vino r: Florentine pork chops with red wine, served over the cavolo nero.
Braciole di maiale marinate in olio e pr: Pork chops marinated in oil and parsley and cooked on the grill.
Bracioline di vitello ripiene di fegatin: Bracelets of veal stuffed with livers, anchovies and juniper, bandaged with lard.

Budino al cacao e amaretti cotto a bagno: Cocoa pudding and amaretti bainmaria bainmaria with caramel. Soft and dark, with caramel colaing on it when turned out: it serves cold, sliced.

Budino di latte a strati di savoiardi, u: Milk pudding with layers of savoiardi, grapes, candied fruits and jams, with kirsch.

Budino di latte, cioccolato e mandorle a: Milk pudding, chocolate and bitter almonds, cooked an hour in bainmaria.
Budino di latte, mollica e mandorle pest: Milk pudding, breadcrumbs and pounded almonds, bain-marie cooked, with eggnog.
Budino di latte, savoiardi e nocciole pe: Milk pudding, savoiardi and hazelnuts pounded, bain-marie cooked.
Budino di pane, latte, uvetta e liquori: Bread pudding, milk, raisins and liqueurs in the caramelized mold, served in flames.
Budino di semolino al latte a strati con: Milk semolina pudding in layers with raspberry and quince jam.
Budino di semolino con pistacchi, uvetta: Semolina pudding with pistachios, raisins and candied fruits, moisten with rum.
Budino di semolino con scorza d'arancia,: Semolina pudding with orange zest, amaretti and egg whites, cooked in the oven.
Budino di spremuta d'arancia addensata c: Orange juice pudding thickened with starch, served cold.
Budino freddo di latte e amido con pinol: Cold pudding of milk and starch with pine nuts and vanilla, served with fruit syrup.

Cappello del prete cotto nell'olio con a: Hat of the priest cooked in oil with anchovies, served with polenta. Soft meat in a thick sauce: it is served hot, with polenta.

Ciotola di riso con salmone al vapore, c: Rice bowl with steamed salmon, carrots, cucumber, sesame seeds and a pink chickpea and beet cream.
Ciotola di riso integrale con cubetti di: Whole rice bowl with raw tuna cubes marinated in soy sauce, ginger and lime, avocado, edamame, cucumber and carrot.

Focaccia bassa di farina di mais impasta: Focaccia low corn flour kneaded with hot water and cooked in the oven, to eat with the vegetables reviewed.
Focaccia di pasta di pane impastata con: Bought bread cake with pork chops and pepper, cooked in the oven.
Focaccia dolce e bassa con i ciccioli di: Sweet and low focaccia with pork pork, dusted with powdered sugar.
Focaccia ferrarese di pasta di pane con: Focaccia Ferrara bread dough with oil, lard and malt, covered with fresh onion in the last leavening: the tyrant zivola wings.
Focaccia lievitata col vino bianco e la: Leavened focaccia with white wine and chopped sage, greased with oil and salt.
Focaccia lievitata di pasta da pane, str: Leavened focaccia of bread, lard and diced ham or bacon: the carsènt of Bologna, for breakfast, snack or frugal lunch.
Focaccina di farina di castagne cotta ne: Chestnut flour focaccin cooked in the text between the chestnut leaves.
Focaccine di vitello e maiale battuti, c: Battered veal and pork pork, cooked with fire and finished with truffle.

Foglie di boragine passate in pastella d: Borage leaves passed in flour and water batter and fried in oil.
Foglie di cavolo cappuccio scottate, tag: Hooded cabbage leaves, cut into strips and marinated one day with vinegar, garlic, chilli and oregano; finally the pumpkin seeds.
Foglie tenere di dente di leone in insal: Leaves tender of lion dentex in salad with oil, vinegar and salt.
Folaghe marinate nell'aceto e stufate co: Folaghe marinated in vinegar and stewed with tomato; with the sauce pappardelle are seasoned.

Fragole congelate e frullate con zuccher: Frozen strawberries and smoothies with icing sugar and lemon peel: a sorbet without ice cream maker.
Fragole passate con succo d'arancia e li: Strawberries passed with orange juice and lemon and syrup, frozen in sorbets.
Fragole, kiwi, banana e mirtilli frullat: Strawberries, kiwis, banana and blueberries milked and frozen in the moulds.
Frattaglie d'agnello con cipolla, vino b: Lamb stew with onion, white wine and chili pepper. Tasty and a little spicy: it is served hot, with bread.
Fregula fatta a mano, scottata e passata: Fregula handmade, cooked and baked in layers with sauce and pecorino.

Friggerle nell'olio caldo e servirle cal: Fry them in hot oil and serve them hot.
Friselle ammorbidite, spalmate di crema: Friselle softened, bean cream scallops and covered with roasted peppers and scallops.
Friselle strofinate d'aglio e spalmate c: Friselle rubbed with garlic and sprinkled with a cream of cauliflower, feta and turmeric, with sesame and flax seeds.
Frittata al forno arrotolata attorno a f: Omelted in the oven rolled around Fontina and stewed spinach, passed in the oven to melt the cheese.
Frittata al forno con melanzane rosolate: Baked omelet with roasted eggplants, tomatoes, olives and basil.
Frittata alta con rafano grattugiato, pa: High frittata with grated horseradish, potatoes and pecorino. High and soft, spicy of horseradish: hot or cold, with wedges.
Frittata alta con ricotta, soppressata,: High frittata with ricotta, soppressata, pecorino and mint, which leads to the Easter Monday's day.
Frittata alta di asparagi stufati con la: High frittata of asparagus stewed with onion, eggs and grain, cooked in the oven without turning it, up to a slight crust.
Frittata alta di molte uova con salumi e: High omelette of many eggs with cold cuts and cheese, Easter day.
Frittata genovese con mollica di pane ba: Genoese frittata with bread crumb, Parmesan cheese and parsley.
Frittata morbida con latte, formaggio ed: Soft frittata with milk, cheese and herbs, in the butter, to serve steaming.
Frittata senza uova fatta con farina di: Omelette without eggs made with chickpea flour and water, with courgettes in pieces, cooked in the oven.
Frittata soffice di uova, farina e latte: Soft omelette of eggs, flour and milk with snow whites, rolled.
Frittatine verdi sottili come carta, tag: Green pancakes as thin as paper, cut into cutters and jump into butter.
Frittelle croccanti di grano saraceno co: Crispy buckwheat pancakes with a melted Casera heart. Small and round, they are eaten hot, freshly fried, on a chicory bed.
Frittelle di Carnevale con uvetta e pino: Carnival pancakes with raisins and pine nuts, pass in sugar. Soft and sugary, you eat warm at Carnival.
Frittelle di farina di castagne al rum e: Chestnut flour pancakes with rum and rosemary, filled with sheep ricotta.
Frittelle di farina di ceci con maggiora: Chickpea flour pancakes with marjoram, cousins of panissa. Inflate and light, you eat hot, just fried.
Frittelle di farina di ceci servite nel: Chickpea pancakes served in the sesame sandwich. Warm and crispy: they are eaten immediately, standing, with lemon.
Frittelle di riso cotto nel latte con sc: Rice pancakes cooked in milk with lemon zest, for March 19. Soft and fragrant lemon: they are eaten lukewarm, passed into sugar.
Frittelle di semolino cotto nel latte co: Semolina pancakes cooked in milk with eggs, rum and lemon, with icing sugar.
Frittelle genovesi di pastella lievitata: Genoese pancakes made of leavened batter with lettuce or herbs. Ready and crunchy, they are eaten hot, freshly fried.
Frittelle natalizie di pasta lievitata,: Christmas pancakes made of leavened pasta, pass through honey or sugar. Soft and sweet, they are eaten at Christmas, hot or warm.
Frittelle salate di farina di ceci cotte: Sauteed chickpea pancakes cooked in a frying pan and served with lemon marinated salmon, onion, tomatoes and rocket.
Frittelle soffici di ricotta, uova e far: Soft pancakes made of ricotta cheese, eggs and flour, passed into the sugar of Carnival.
Frittelle sottili di farina e acqua cott: Fine pancakes of flour and water cooked on the Romagna text with a hint of oil and a pinch of sugar: the “pancake” of the farmers of Rimini.
Frittura dolce e salata: carni, frattagl: Sweet and salty frying: meats, offals, vegetables, sweet semolina and amaretti. It is on the table waves, just fried: it is the dish of the festivals in Piedmont.
Frolla ripiena di semolino cotto nel lat: Frolla stuffed with semolina cooked in milk with pine nuts, closed to grate.
Frullato denso di albicocche, carote e m: Blend dense apricots, carrots and green apple with almond milk, honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Frutta cotta al forno sotto una copertur: Fruit baked under a cover of crispy flour crumbs, oat flakes, almonds and little butter.
Frutta d'estate a pezzetti con zucchero: Summer fruit in small pieces with sugar and lemon, frosted like a marble.
Funghi freschi soffritti con aglio, poi: Fresh mushrooms fried with garlic, then closed in eggs, soft and oregano.
Funghi pleurotus e porcini saltati, aspa: Pleurotus mushrooms and sautéed porcini, boiled asparagus and rocket, with a sauce of roasted tomatoes in the oven and smoothies with herbs and vinegar.
Fusilli con punte di asparagi rosolate c: Fusilli with bits of browned asparagus with shallots, tuna in oil and parsley.
Fusilli con totani cotti nel vino bianco: Fusilli with totani cooked in white wine, wrapped in a sauce blended with boiled asparagus and toasted almonds.
Fusilli con vongole aperte in padella, a: Fusilli with clams open in pan, asparagus with rounds and grated lemon peel.
Fusilli fatti al ferretto conditi col ra: Fusilli made from the ferret seasoned with Sunday ragù and caciocavallo. Long ragu of meat, red and dense: the Sunday dish in Cilento.
Fusilli integrali su una crema di pisell: Whole-grain fusilli on a cream of peas and mint, with whole peas, chopped pistachios and lemon peel.
Galletta grattugiata e tostata, versata: Grated and toasted gallet, poured into the boiling broth and served with Parmesan cheese.
Gallina ripiena di fegatini, uova, pomod: Chicken stuffed with livers, eggs, dried tomatoes and saffron, boiled and grilled.
Gamberetti grigi della laguna fritti o l: Gray shrimps of the fried or boiled lagoon, served on soft white polenta. Small and sweet, they are eaten with soft white polenta: Venetian appetizer.
Gelato veloce senza gelatiera: polpa d'a: Fast ice cream without ice cream: frozen orange pulp blended with sugar and yogurt.
Germano stufato con cipolla e prosciutto: Germano stew with onion and ham, surrounded by broccoli flavoured in its bottom.
Girello di manzo cotto piano nel suo sug: Girello di manzo baked slowly in his sauce, only salt and pepper: the Bologna race.
Gnocchetti di farina e acqua bollente, c: Gnocchetti flour and boiling water, seasoned with melted butter and browned breadcrumbs.
Gnocchetti di farina tostata nello strut: Toasted flour gnocchi in the lard, seasoned with browned onions.
Gnocchetti di pane bagnato nel latte con: Bread gnocchi soaked in milk with egg and butter, cooked flat in the broth.
Gnocchetti di pane e farina con sugo di: Gnocchetti of bread and flour with sauce of borlotti beans and tomato. Poor and substantial dish: it is served hot, with Parmesan cheese.
Gnocchetti di patate cotte nel latte, fr: Potato gnocchi cooked in milk, fried and passed into sugar and cinnamon.
Gnocchetti di polenta dolce al latte, co: Sweet milk polenta gnocchi, seasoned with sugar, cinnamon and melted butter.
Gnocchetti di ricotta di Viceno e spinac: Viceno ricotta and spinach gnocchi, seasoned with butter and sage.
Gnocchetti di ricotta e parmigiano senza: Gnocchetti of ricotta and Parmesan without puff pastry and vegetables, meat sauce.
Gnocchetti di semolino cotto nel latte c: Semolina gnocchi cooked in milk with butter, egg and cheese, in the broth.
Gnocchetti di vitello e prosciutto pesta: Gnocchetti of veal and ham beaten, tied with bread and egg, cooked in the broth.
Gnocchetti morbidi di ricotta, bietole e: Soft gnocchi made of ricotta cheese, chards and wholemeal flour, without eggs, served on a cream of curry carrots.
Gnocchetti rigati di semola e zafferano: Gnocchetti striped with semolina and saffron with sausage and pecorino sauce. Small and striped, they collect well the sauce: it is one of the first known in Sardinia.
Gnocchetti verdi di spinaci passati nell: Green spinach gnocchi passed in the appropriate tool, with cream and speck. Soft and irregular: they are served immediately, hot.
Gnocchettini di burro, uova e pangrattat: Gnocchettini of butter, eggs and breadcrumbs cooked over moderate heat in the broth.
Gnocchi allungati di ricotta, erbe e for: Gnocchi elongated ricotta, herbs and cheese, cooked in broth and gratin. They are served hot, gratinized: typical dish of Alexandrino.
Gnocchi di pane bianco ammollato nel lat: Gnocchi of white bread soaked in milk with eggs, boiled and seasoned with butter.
Gnocchi di pane raffermo e spinaci, con: Gnocchi of stale bread and spinach, with melted butter, sage and grain. Soft and tasty: they serve hot with melted butter, freshly drained.
Gnocchi di patate con farina di castagne: Potato gnocchi with chestnut flour, seasoned with walnut and pine nuts sauce.
Gnocchi di patate con sugo di pomodoro,: Potato gnocchi with tomato sauce, mozzarella filante and basil, gratinati. Serve hot in the pyrophyline, with mozzarella filante.
Gnocchi di patate e farina a truciolo, a: Gnocchi of potatoes and chip flour, layered with pesto and Parmesan.
Gnocchi di patate saltati con gambi di a: Jumped potato gnocchi with stems of asparagus with rounds, whole tips and tomatoes added to the last.
Gnocchi di patate veronesi conditi con b: Gnocchi of Veronese potatoes seasoned with melted butter, cheese and a little sugar and cinnamon, as on Friday gnocolar.
Gnocchi di polenta di grano saraceno all: Gnocchi of buckwheat polenta with oil, seasoned with butter and cheese.
Gnocchi di semolino cotto nel latte e le: Gnocchi of semolina cooked in milk and tied with eggs, boiled and seasoned with butter.
Gnocchi rustici fatti solo con broccoli: Rustic gnocchi made only with boiled broccoli and flour, sautéed with garlic chards and dried tomatoes.
Gran fetta di vitello arrotolata su anim: Great slice of veal rolled on animelle, ham and vegetables, excellent cold.
Grande fetta di manzo arrotolata su un r: Big slice of rolled beef on a filling of veal, tongue and ham, roast.
Grande frittata con listelle di prosciut: Big omelette with strips of ham, parsley and breadcrumbs.
Grande guscio di pasta sfoglia ripieno d: Large shell of puff pastry filled with sweetbreads, livers and truffles.
Grande lievitato natalizio con uvetta e: Great Christmas leavened with raisins and candied orange and cedar. High and soft, it is served as slices at Christmas, alone or with mascarpone cream.
Grande pasticcio freddo di lepre marinat: Great cold mess of hare marinated in marsala, with tongue and truffle.
Grandi cappellacci ripieni di zucca viol: Big chapels filled with violin pumpkin and Parmesan, with butter and sage or ragù. Sweet pumpkin filling, seasoned with butter and sage: the first in the autumn of Ferrara.
Granelli di montone lessati, a filetti,: Boiled mutton grains, fillets, floured, passed into the egg and fried.
Granita cremosa di mandorle siciliane se: Granita creamy of Sicilian almonds served with the brioche with the tuppo. Fresh and creamy, it is the summer breakfast in Sicily: you dip the brioche.
Grano cotto con melagrana, noci, cioccol: Baked wheat with pomegranate, walnuts, chocolate and vincotto, for November 2nd. It is served cold, in cups, on the day of the dead.
Grigliata di pesce azzurro dell'Adriatic: Grilled with blue fish of the Adriatic: sardines and saraghini panate with breadcrumbs, oil and parsley and cooked over a live heat on the grill, even inside the piadina.
Grossi gnocchi di pane raffermo, speck e: Big dumplings of stale bread, speck and eggs, cooked and served in broth. Big like a mandarin, scented of speck: they are served in holsters with hot broth.
Grossi spaghetti integrali con salsa di: Gross whole-grain spaghetti with onions sauce and stewed anchovies. Ruvid and tasty pasta, sweet sauce of onion and anchovies: it is the Venetian dish of thin.
Grumetti di farina e acqua cotti nel lat: Bunch of flour and water cooked in milk, sprinkled with pepper or sugar.
Grumi sferici di semola 'benedetta' con: Spherical grains of 'blessed' semolina with water, seasoned with tomato sauce. Small and irregular, collect the sauce: they serve hot with cheese.
Guscio di frolla con pan di Spagna, crem: Short shell with Spanish bread, cream and baked meringue cover.
Guscio di pasta brisée con una crema di: Pasta shell brisée with a cream of mushrooms and smoothies peas and the tips of asparagus on it.
Guscio di pasta frolla cotto a parte, ri: Pasta shell cooked separately, filled with pastry cream and covered with strawberries and blueberries.
Hamburger di lenticchie frullate con car: Lentils burger smoothed with carrot, corn flour, curry and capers, browned in a frying pan and served with lemon.
Hamburger di patate e zucchine lessate c: Potato burgers and zucchini boiled with carrot and onion, egg and Parmesan, breaded and baked in the oven.
Hamburger di patate, carote, piselli e f: Potato burgers, carrots, peas and green beans boiled and chopped with bread soaked in vinegar, golden in a frying pan.
Hamburger vegetali di zucchine, fagioli: Vegetable courgettes, cinnamon beans and onion baked in the oven and served in the tomato and mozzarella sandwich.
I pasticcini morbidi di sole mandorle, z: The soft pastries of almonds, sugar and white, without flour: crispy outside and tender inside.
I primi fichi ancora verdi, incisi a cro: The first figs still green, engraved on a cross, boiled and then passed in flour and egg and fried: a fried early summer Neapolitan cuisine that does not throw anything.
Il ripieno dei cappelletti, ricotta e pe: The filling of cappelletti, ricotta and chicken breast, cooked with spoons in the broth.
Il tondone, frittata di farina e acqua,: The round, omelette of flour and water, beaten with eggs and fried with bombs.

Insalata di lattuga condita all'olio e a: Lettuce salad seasoned with oil and vinegar with hard-boiled eggs.
Insalata di riso integrale con feta a cu: Insalata di riso integrale con feta a cubetti, pomodorini, olive nere edamame.
Insalata di stagione con spicchi di aran: Season salad with orange and grapefruit cloves, fennel and a sauce with citrus juice.

Involtini di cotica ripieni di aglio e p: Chop rolls filled with garlic and parsley, cooked in sheep's sauce.
Involtini di filetto di maiale ripieni d: Pork fillet rolls filled with cold cuts and cheese, in white or with tomato sauce: the small version of the “valigia” by Reggio Emilia.

Purè di fave secche con cicoria selvatic: Pure dried broad beans with boiled wild chicory and raw oil. Smooth puree and a little bitter chicory: it is served warm with abundant raw oil.
Purè di lenticchie insaporito con soffri: Pure lentils flavoured with sautéed vegetables and broth, firm and velvety.
Purè di patate con balsamella, uova e pa: Potato mashed potatoes with balsamella, eggs and Parmesan cheese, baked in a baking tray.
Purè di patate con burro, uova, latte e: Potato mashed potatoes with butter, eggs, milk and parsley, cooked in a frying pan and rolled.
Purè di patate passate al setaccio con b: Potato mashed potatoes sieved with butter and milk, to garnish boiled and moist.
Purè di piselli secchi col soffritto al: Plum of dried peas with butter and tomato fried, served with croutons.
Purè leggero di cavolfiore e patate frul: Purè light cauliflower and potatoes smoothed with Parmesan cheese, nutmeg and a little oil, without butter or milk.
Quadretti di cervello e besciamella soda: Brain squares and firm béchamel, breaded and fried in the lard.
Quadretti di pane al burro con foglie di: Butter bread squares with parsley leaves and anchovies fillets.
Quadrotti di polenta fritti, street food: Fried polenta squares, Bari Vecchia street food. Crunchy outside and soft inside: they eat hot, freshly fried, with salt.
Quadrotti di purè di patate, burro e tuo: Squares of mashed potatoes, butter and egg yolks, breaded in white and fried.
Quaglie al burro e salvia, servite su cr: Butter and sage quails, serve on golden bread croutons in their bottom.
Quaglie rosolate col prosciutto e cotte: Quails browned with ham and cooked together with rice in broth, with Parmesan cheese.
Quarti posteriori di coniglio lardellati: Back quarters of larded rabbit, greasy with butter and roasted.
Quarto di lepre lardellato di prosciutto: Quarter of ham lardelate hare, stewed in half and finished on the spit.
Quattro creme gialla, bruna, verde e ros: Four yellow, brunette, green and red creams poured into a cup.
Quattro legumi secchi con soffritto alla: Four dried legumes with saintly fried and macaroni in the broth.
Quinoa con carote e cipolla appassite, p: Quinoa with carrots and dried onion, peas, olives, diced feta and semi-dry tomatoes.
Quinoa con edamame, asparagi lessati, sp: Quinoa with plums, boiled asparagus, fresh spinach, rocket and fresh peas, seasoned only with oil.
Quinoa con melanzane lunghe e zucchine s: Quinoa with long eggplants and courgettes with garlic, parsley and mint.
Quinoa ed edamame freddi con noci, semi: Quinoa and cold plums with nuts, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, chia and flax and goji berries, seasoned with soy sauce and oil.
Quinoa lessata e poi tostata in forno fi: Boiled quinoa and then toasted in the oven until it is crispy, with roasted asparagus, edamame, avocado and a condiment of tahina, lime and ginger.
Quinoa servita su una crema di zucca con: Quinoa served on a pumpkin cream with champignon trifolati with thyme.
Radicchio e finocchi affettati con primo: Radicchio and fennel sliced with first salt, apples, hazelnuts and a sauce of honey, oil and apple vinegar.
Radicchio, lattughino, finocchio a julie: Radicchio, lettuce, julienne fennel and orange cloves with edamame and balsamic vinegar.
Radicchio, mele e feta a cubetti con cas: Radicchio, apples and feta in cubes with crumbled chestnuts, seasoned with oil and balsamic vinegar.
Radici di scorzonera lessate con un po': Scorzonera roots boiled with some flour and seasoned with oil, salt and pepper.
Radici di scorzonera stufate nel soffrit: Scorzonera roots stewed in the fried and tied with egg yolks and lemon.
Ragù di frattaglie, creste e animelle in: Ragus of offal, ridges and sweet-and-sweet anime with Marsala. Rich and dark, it serves hot as a single dish or in a sheet.
Ramolaccio grattato o a fette sottili, c: Grated or thin-sliced breadcrumbs, seasoned with oil, salt and pepper.
Ranocchi cotti col pomodoro e passati, c: Ranocchi cooked with tomato and past, with bone legs and mushrooms, on bread.
Rape dolci lessate a bastoncini e carame: Sweet turnips boiled with sticks and caramelized in the lard with sugar.
Rape inacidite nelle vinacce, stufate e: Unacided turnips in the pomace, stewed and served with Friulian cotechino. Acid flavour of the turnips and fat of the facet: Friulian dish in winter.
Ravioli 'panciuti' ripieni di preboggion: Ravioli 'panciuti' stuffed with preboggion and herbs, with creamy nut sauce. They are served with walnut sauce and a sprinkle of Parmesan: dish of Genoa.
Ravioli a spiga ripieni di patate, pecor: Ravioli with ears filled with potatoes, pecorino cheese, mint and garlic. Hand-shaped cloves: they are served with tomato sauce and pecorino cheese.
Ravioli di cappone, cervello, animelle e: Capon ravioli, brain, animelle and livers with spinach, butter and cheese.
Ravioli di pasta all'uovo ripieni di ric: Ravioli of egg pasta stuffed with sheep's ricotta, pecorino cheese and parsley, seasoned with tomato sauce and basil.
Ravioli di pasta di semola ripieni di fo: Ravioli of semolina pasta filled with fresh sheep cheese, sugar and lemon peel, boiled and seasoned with sugar and cinnamon.
Ravioli di scarola, borragine, salsiccia: Scarola ravioli, borage, sausage and ricotta, with veal sauce.
Ravioli dolci fritti di Natale ripieni d: Sweet fried Christmas ravioli filled with chickpeas, chestnuts, chocolate and cooked must. Crunching out and soft inside: they are served at Christmas, dusted with sugar.
Ravioli dolci fritti ripieni di castagne: Sweet fried ravioli filled with chestnuts, chickpeas, chocolate and cooked must. Croccanti out and soft inside: they serve dusted sugar, at Christmas.
Ravioli fritti di zucca e brussu della V: Fried pumpkin ravioli and Brussu of Val Nervia. Crunching outside and soft inside: they are eaten hot, as an appetizer.
Ravioli genovesi di pollo, piccione, vit: Genoese ravioli of chicken, pigeon, veal and borage, with veal sauce.
Ravioli liguri ripieni di zucca e carni: Ligurian ravioli stuffed with pumpkin and veal meat, seasoned with beef sauce.
Raviolo di frolla ripieno di mostarda bo: Raviolo with shorts stuffed with Bolognese mustard, baked in the oven. Friable outside, sweet and spicy filling: served at the end of the meal.
Ribes e ciliegie scure passati con limon: Currants and dark cherries passed with lemon and syrup: red and sour sorbet.
Ricotta fresca mescolata con zucchero e: Fresh ricotta mixed with sugar and rum, served with slices of bread.
Riempire con il composto stampini a semi: Fill with the mixture half-sphere molds (or pirottini) of 5 cm, buttered and floured, for two thirds.
Ripieno di zucca, amaretti e mostarda di: Filled with pumpkin, amaretti and apple mustard, with melted butter and grain. Sweet filling, spicy mustard: it's the Christmas Eve dish in Mantova.
Riso Vialone cotto a vapore nella pentol: Risco Vialone steamed in the pot and seasoned with sausage pesto. Chicchi and dry, not mantecati: it is the risotto of the “piloti” and those involved in the pile of Mantovano rice.
Riso al burro e parmigiano assodato in f: Butter rice and Parmesan seasoned in the oven, served with stewed chicken strips.
Riso al sugo con trito di vitello e parm: Rice with gravy with veal and Parmesan, crusted in a pan.
Riso all'onda con piselli novelli, quasi: Riso all'onda with new peas, almost a soup. You eat with a spoon, green and scented of fresh peas: it is the spring dish of Venice.
Riso cotto a lungo nel latte con vanigli: Rice cooked for a long time in milk with vanilla and rum, lightened with egg whites.
Riso cotto adagio nel latte, con uova, l: Adagio cooked rice in milk, with eggs, lemon, pine nuts and amaretti, baked in the oven.
Riso cotto con bietole, cavolo novello e: Rice cooked with chards, new cabbage and parsley, finished with garlic pesto.
Riso cotto nel brodo di pollo e legato c: Rice cooked in chicken broth and tied with butter, Parmesan and egg yolks, for the boil.
Riso cotto nel latte con burro e parmigi: Rice cooked in milk with butter and Parmesan cheese, with breaded and fried cylinders.
Rice cooked in milk with butter and Parmesan cheese, tied with egg yolks: a liquid risotto.
Riso cotto nel latte con uovo e mele a f: Rice cooked in milk with egg and apple slices, baked and roasted in pieces.
Riso cotto nel latte e legato con parmig: Rice baked in milk and tied with Parmesan cheese and egg yolks, dropped in spoonfuls in breadcrumbs and fried: the Neapolitan rice crucché of the nineteenth century, without filling.
Riso cotto nel sugo di tinche passate al: Rice cooked in the sauce of tinche passed through the sieve, with peas or mushrooms.
Riso cotto nell'acqua, mescolando spesso: Rice cooked in water, stirring often so that it becomes creamy without butter, saffron yellow and scented lemon, fennel and pistachio.
Riso di magro trentino, cotto nell'acqua: Rice of thin Trentino, cooked in water on the sauté of oil, onion and sardines.
Riso e farro cotti insieme come un risot: Rice and spelt cooked together like a risotto with asparagus, mantecati and served as a pie with raw tomatoes.
Riso integrale freddo con ceci, fagioli: Cold whole rice with chickpeas, red beans and peas, pepper, tomatoes and onions, seasoned with lemon and basil.
Riso nero con ceci, zucchina a dadini, p: Black rice with chickpeas, courgettes, tomatoes and a seasoning of lemon and mint.
Riso nero con edamame e gamberetti al va: Black rice with steamed almonds and shrimp, corn and a lime citronette.
Riso nero integrale con asparagi e pisel: Whole black rice with asparagus and salted peas, toasted almonds and lemon peel.
Riso tostato a lungo nel burro con pezze: Long toasted rice in butter with pieces of old caciocavallo made golden, then cooked in the broth until it remains dry: neither soup nor risotto, a first Neapolitan of the nineteenth century.
Riso tostato con un soffritto di cipolla: Toasted rice with a fried onion, carrot, celery and leek, cooked in broth.
Riso, farro e orzo freddi con asparagi s: Rice, spelt and cold barley with salted asparagus, turkey puss cubes, green olives and red onion.
Risotto al burro cotto ad acqua e insapo: Risotto with butter cooked in water and flavoured in half with tomato sauce.
Risotto al burro e cipolla, cotto ad acq: Butter and onion risotto, cooked with water, finished with dried peas.
Risotto al fumetto di lago con persico b: Risotto in the lake comic with beaten perch and a spiral of lemon cream.
Risotto allo zafferano mantecato con bur: Risotto with saffron mantecato with butter and grain, with bone marrow of ox. Yellow gold, creamy and “all'onda”: it is served alone or with the bone hole.
Risotto bianco con cipolla, brodo di car: White risotto with onion, meat broth, butter and Parmesan cheese, served with white truffle or roast sauce.
Risotto col brodo dei gamberi di fiume p: Risotto with broth of beaten river prawns, with bigger whole shrimps.
Risotto colorato con cavolo cappuccio vi: Colored risotto with violet cabbage stewed with onion, finished with Parmesan cheese and raw oil.
Risotto con asparagi a tocchetti, mantec: Risotto with asparagus in tocchetti, mantecato with stracchino and finished with toasted hazelnut grains.
Risotto con carote e cipolla, mantecato: Risotto with carrots and onion, mantecato with crescenza and Parmesan instead of butter.
Risotto con fagioli, cotenne e salam d'l: Risotto with beans, cotenne and salam d'la duja. Dense and tasty, a rustic risotto in winter: it is served hot.
Risotto con le verdure della primavera:: Risotto with spring vegetables: zucchini, asparagus, peas and artichokes.
Risotto con seppie in umido, bietola e i: Risotto with wet cuttlefish, chard and their black. Black and creamy, tasty sea: it is served immediately.
Risotto con vitello tritato, cervello e: Risotto with chopped calf, brain and marrow, finished with saffron and Parmesan.
Risotto cotto nell'acqua delle telline,: Risotto cooked in the water of the telline, with sautéed vegetables and dried mushrooms.
Risotto di magro con acciughe salate, fu: Skinny risotto with salted anchovies, dried mushrooms, butter and Parmesan cheese, without salt.
Risotto di magro con gamberi di fiume, r: Skinny risotto with river prawns, frogs and peas, born at the Certosa di Pavia. Delicate and tasty fresh water: it is served hot, freshly mantecato.
Risotto di riso integrale con asparagi,: Risotto of whole rice with asparagus, cooked in a broth made at the moment and finished only with raw oil, without butter.
Risotto in bianco con filetti di persico: White risotto with golden perch fillets in butter and sage. The fish remains crispy over the creamy rice: it is served immediately.
Risotto mantecato col brodo di ghiozzo d: Risotto mantecato with soup of gobble of the lagoon, Burano dish. Delicate and creamy, tasty lagoon: it is served immediately, at the wave.
Risotto mantecato col brodo e la polpa d: Risotto mantecato with broth and the flesh of the rice frogs. Delicate and creamy: the risotto of the rice fields of Pavia and Vercelli.
Risotto mantecato con luganega di Monza: Risotto mantecato con luganega di Monza crumbled. Creamy and tasty sausage: it is served immediately with Parmesan cheese.
Risotto mantecato con radicchio tardivo: Risotto mantecato with late radicchio stew and red wine. Dark red, bitter and creamy: it is done in winter, when there is the late.
Risotto semplice finito con salsiccia sb: Simple risotto finished with crumbled sausage, tomato and cheese.
Risotto senza burro con la zucca cotta a: Risotto without butter with pumpkin cooked separately, white wine, rosemary and walnut keriglia.
Risotto sfumato e cotto con Barolo, mant: Risotto shaded and cooked with Barolo, mantecato with butter and Parmesan. Dark red and scented wine: it is served immediately, warm.
Ritagliare i biscotti con l'apposito sta: Cut the cookies with the special six-petal flower mold (or a 6 cm sleek biscuit cutter) and make the hole in the middle with a cap or a small cuppasta.
Ritagliare le pastine con un tagliapasta: Cut the pasta with a round cutter of 5 cm: about 50 of them come.
Ritagliare le sfogliatine con un tagliap: Cut the dough with a round cutter of 5 cm, pressing well around the filling, and put them on the baking tray with baking paper.
Rocchi d'anguilla marinati con olio e li: Eel rocks marinated with oil and lemon, roasted on the spit with sage.
Rocchi d'anguilla rosolati con aglio, sa: Rocchi d'anguila browned with garlic, sage and lemon, then cooked in wine and tomato.
Rognone a fettine sbollentato, saltato n: Boiled kidney, sautéed in butter with white wine and parsley.
Rognone di vitello alla griglia a fettin: Broiled veal kidney in slices, in soft frittata folded in half.
Rognoni a fettine saltati nel burro con: Sliced kidneys in butter with parsley, garlic and lemon, on toasted bread.
Rognoni di maiale a fettine cotti in un: Pork rognoni in slices cooked in a fried garlic and parsley with tomato.
Rognoni di vitello alla graticola servit: Grey veal rognoni served with a sauce of liver and lemon.
Rognoni di vitello o di maiale marinati: Calf or pork rognoni marinated in oil, garlic and pepper and cooked on the heat.
Rombi di pasta fritta gonfi e cavi, da m: Rhombi of puffy fried pasta and cables, to eat with cold meats. Warm and light, you can eat immediately with ham, salami and cup.
Rondelle di zucchina saltate a fuoco viv: Sautéed courgettes in oil and scented with oregano.
Rose di sfoglia fritta inzuppate nel vin: Fried puffy roses soaked in vincotto or honey. Crunchy and shiny vincotto: they are eaten at Christmas, in Puglia.
Rose di sfoglia ripiene di noci, uvetta: Roses of puff pastry filled with walnuts, raisins and honey, cooked in a pan. It is served at room temperature, in slices: the sweet of the feasts of San Giovanni in Fiore.
Rosolare cipolla e lardo nel burro chiar: Sauté onion and lard in clarified butter and oil with sage and rosemary.
Rosolare dolcemente le cipolle affettate: Sauté the sliced onions in the rest of the butter gently.
Rosolare i fegatini con una piccola part: Brown the livers with a small portion of garlic, onion, sage and rosemary.
Rosolare il cosciotto di capra con carot: Sauté the goat's leg with carrot, celery and chopped onion, cover with water and cook slowly; add sauce and peel and finish cooking the sauce.
Rosolare il guanciale a listarelle, togl: Sauté the pillow in strips, remove it and fry onion and zucchini in the remaining fat.
Sauté the lard in a pan.
Rosolare il pezzente con olio e aglio, s: Sauté the piece with oil and garlic, deglaze with the white wine and add the tomato sauce.
Rosolare il trito in casseruola con la c: Sauté the chopped casserole with the minced meat over low heat, stirring often.
Rosolare in padella con un filo d'olio l: Sauté the crumbled sausages in a frying pan with a little oil.
Rosolare l'aglio in 4 cucchiai d'olio, t: Sauté the garlic in 4 tablespoons of oil, remove and add the tomatoes, salt and chilli.
Sauté the garlic in three tablespoons of oil.
Rosolare l'aglio nell'olio, unire il cap: Brown the garlic in the oil, add the kid and brown it.
Rosolare l'altro spicchio d'aglio nell'o: Sauté the other clove of garlic in the oil in a pan and remove it.
Rosolare l'oca con l'olio su tutti i lat: Sauté the goose with oil on all sides.
Rosolare la carne di cinghiale a cubetti: Sauté the meat of wild boar in cubes and deglaze with the red wine.
Rosolare la carne nell'olio e scaldare a: Sauté the meat in the oil and heat aside the tomato sauce.
Sauté the sliced onion in butter.
Rosolare la cipolla tritata con olio e p: Sauté the chopped onion with oil and chilli.
Rosolare la cipollina nell'olio, unire l: Sauté the chives in the oil, add the remaining grouper in pieces, the tomatoes, the wine, parsley, capers and chilli; add some cooking water and narrow.
Rosolare la pancetta a listarelle e vers: Sauté the bacon in strips and pour it hot on the cabbage.
Rosolare la pasta di lucanica sbriciolat: Sauté the crumbled lucanica paste and place it on the bottom of the bowls.
Rosolare la salsiccetta sbriciolata e te: Sauté the crumbled sausage and keep it aside.
Sauté the meat into small pieces.
Rosolare le cipolline nell'olio in casse: Sauté the onions in the oil in casserole.
Rosolare le verdure nell'olio in una pen: Sauté the vegetables in the oil in a high pot, then add the potatoes to pieces and the meat.
Rosolare metà del battuto di sedano, car: Sauté half of the chopped celery, carrot and onion in the oil and cook the vegetables.
Rosolare nell'olio l'altra cipolla e l'a: Sauté the other onion and garlic in the oil.
Rosolare nell'olio la cipolla affettata: Sauté the sliced onion and pepper into the oil.
Rosolare nell'olio la cipolla tritata, l: Sauté the chopped onion, the meat and the crumbled sausages in the oil.
Rosolare nell'olio la polpa di maiale co: Sauté the pork pulp with garlic, sausage, ribs and onion in the oil.
Rosolare nell'olio un trito di sedano, c: Sauté in the oil a chopped celery, carrot and onion.
Sauté it in oil on all sides.
Rosolarli in un tegame con l'olio, a pia: Sauté them in a pan with oil, to taste with chopped basil and parsley.
Rosolarlo leggermente in padella con oli: Slightly brown it in a pan with oil and rosemary.
Rotella di tonno steccata col rosmarino: Tuna wheel with rosemary and roasted on the grill with oil.
Rotelle di palombo marinate nell'uovo, i: Palombo rolls marinated in the egg, breaded with Parmesan cheese and herbs, fried.
Rotelle di panino al latte bagnate nel l: Milk sandwich rolls soaked in sweet milk, breaded and fried.
Rotolo di pan di Spagna bagnato col roso: Roll of pan of Spain soaked with rose oil, with jam and candied fruit.
Rovesciare sulla spianatoia infarinata e: Turn over on the floured slab and, as soon as you can touch it, form a cord of 4 cm of diameter.
Rucola con fagioli, cetrioli, pomodori e: Rucola with beans, cucumbers, tomatoes and walnuts, seasoned with lemon and balsamic vinegar: a complete vegetable meal.
Rucola con mela a cubetti, chicchi di me: Rucola with apple cubes, pomegranate beans, feta and pumpkin seeds, seasoned with lemon and oil.
Salare, coprire e cuocere a fuoco basso,: Salt, cover and cook over low heat, occasionally soaking with little cold water.
Salmone marinato alle erbe e grigliato,: Salmon marinated with herbs and grilled, served on lettuce, red onion, tomatoes, anchovies and black olives.
Salsa calda di aglio, acciughe e olio in: Hot garlic sauce, anchovies and oil in which to dip raw and cooked vegetables. We eat in autumn and winter, in company, keeping the pan warm in the middle of the table.
Salsicce cotte senza grassi in tegame, c: Sausages cooked without fat in pan, with the eggs represented in their bottom.
Salsicce infarinate cotte piano in tegam: Sausages floured cooked flat in pan with slices of apple and little water.
Salsicce piccole rosolate e finite con f: Sausages with mushrooms, shallots, sage and white wine, served on the steaming polenta with their sauce.
Salsiccia di vitello e maiale da mangiar: Sausage of veal and pork to eat raw, seasoned with oil and lemon. Delicate and rosé, you eat raw immediately after buying it.
Saltare il salame a dadini con olio, agl: Jump the salami into cubes with oil, garlic and chilli.
Saltare le interiora col sugo rimasto e: Skip the entrails with the remaining sauce and tomato concentrate and pour them on.
Saltarla nel sugo con poca acqua di cott: Jump into the sauce with little cooking water and serve with pecorino cheese.
Saltarla nel sugo di ceci e broccoletti,: Salt it in the sauce of chickpeas and broccoli, remove the bay leaf and season with raw extra virgin olive oil.
Saltarle con la crema, 2 cucchiai d'acqu: Toss them with the cream, 2 tablespoons of cooking water and the oil remaining raw.
Saltarli con cozze e pomodori, unire ruc: Salt them with mussels and tomatoes, add rocket, pecorino cream, basil, salt, oil, pepper and a ladle of cooking water.
Saltarli in tegame con burro, salvia, ti: Jump them in a pan with butter, sage, thyme and Parmesan and serve hot.
Saltarli nel burro con l'uvetta ammollat: Jump them in butter with raisins soaked.
Saltarli nel sugo con metà delle melanza: Jump them into the sauce with half the eggplants.
Saltarli nella padella con il condimento: Jump into the pan with the seasoning and half of the pecorino cheese, adding cooking water if needed.
Sarde aperte e farcite di mollica, acciu: Open sardines and stuffed with breadcrumbs, anchovies and oregano, breadcrumbs and fried.
Sarde arrotolate su mollica, uvetta, pin: Sards rolled on soft, raisins, pine nuts and citrus fruits, baked. Filled sweet and golden sour: they are served lukewarm or at room temperature.
Sarde fritte marinate in cipolle all'ace: Fried sardines marinated in vinegar onions with raisins and pine nuts. They eat cold, the next day: it is the dish of the Feast of the Redeemer.
Sardelle cotte in tegame sul pangrattato: Sardelle cooked in pan on the breadcrumbs fried with garlic and lemon zest.
Sardine sotto sale dissalate, aperte e f: Sardines under salt desalate, open and fried in flour and water batter.
Savoiardi al marsala con uvetta e candit: Savoiardi marsala with raisins and candied fruit, cooked in a cream and covered with eggnog.
Savoiardi al rosolio e all'alchermes a s: Savoiards with rose oil and alchermes in layers with cream of butter and chocolate.
Savoiardi bagnati nel rosolio a strati c: Savoiards soaked in rosole layered with fruit jams, without cooking.
Savoiardi inzuppati nel caffè, crema di: Savoiards soaked in coffee, mascarpone cream and eggs, bitter cocoa. It serves cold, spoonfuls or squares: soft, with the flavour of coffee and cocoa.
Sbollentare il tarassaco, scolarlo, bras: Boil the dandelion, drain it, braise it in a sauté and chop it cold.
Sbollentare le mandorle 1 minuto, spella: Boil the almonds 1 minute, peel and dry in the oven at 100 °C for 15 minutes; split in half the bigger ones (one third) and cut the others into fillets.
Sbollentare mandorle e nocciole 1 minuto: Boil almonds and hazelnuts 1 minute, peel and dry in the oven at 120 °C for 10 minutes.
Sbriciolare la pizza di granturco e salt: Crush the corn pizza and toss it with the vegetables, or serve it next door.
Sbucciare le mandorle dolci e le mandorl: Peel the sweet almonds and bitter almonds after 2 minutes in boiling water, dry in the oven at 100 °C for 10 minutes and chop them finely with 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Sbucciare le mandorle dolci, asciugarle: Peel the sweet almonds, dry them and toast them in the oven at 160 °C 10 minutes, until they are hazelnut color.
Sbucciare le mele, tagliarle a dadini e: Peel the apples, cut them into cubes and mix them in a 20 cm baking dish with berries, 20 g cane sugar and cinnamon.
Scaldare 60 g di strutto in una teglia d: Heat 60 g of lard in a pan of 26 cm on the heat and, when it begins to rub, pour the dough and level it with the ladle.
Scaldare abbondante olio in una padella: Heat abundant oil in a deep frying pan and fry the pancakes.
Scaldare il forno a 170 °C e imburrare e: Heat the oven at 170 °C and butter and flour a doughnut mould of 24 cm.
Scaldare il forno a 170 °C; ungere con i: Heat the oven at 170 °C; grease with butter a 24 cm mold and dust with a veil of flour.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C e foderare un: Heat the oven at 180 °C and cover a baking tray with baking paper.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C e imburrare u: Heat the oven at 180 °C and butter a pan of 24 cm.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C; imburrare e: Heat the oven at 180 °C; butter and flour the molds, or a 24x30 cm baking pan.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C; imburrare un: Heat the oven at 180 °C; butter a high smooth mould (16 cm in diameter, 12 cm in height) and dust with icing sugar and flour.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C; ungere una t: Heat the oven at 180 °C; grease a pan with a veil of lard and flour it.
Scaldare il forno a 230 °C, bagnare i pa: Heat the oven at 230 °C, wet the loaves with cold water and bake them.
Scaldare il latte con la scorza di limon: Heat the milk with lemon zest without boiling it; remove the zest.
Scaldare il latte senza farlo bollire e: Heat the milk without boiling it and throw the eggs in it with a whisk.
Scaldare l'olio con l'altro spicchio d'a: Heat the oil with the other clove of garlic and rosemary, brown the cloves and deglaze with the white wine.
Scaldare l'olio extravergine d'oliva in: Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a cottage pan, add the chopped and rosemary and brown.

Spiedini di vitello, fegato, animelle, c: Spiedini of veal, liver, animelle, artichoke and sage, breaded and fried.
